name: Admin Dashboard Attention Radar
description: Dashboard attention accordions list five records at a time, open current details and navigate to exact records with visual focus. Desktop expanded records use two compact columns with independently selectable cards; the detail dialog is capped at 48rem. Counts represent pending elements; missing records, permission denials and network retries have explicit feedback. Includes collection accounts with a pending linked document as a superuser-only financial alert, excluding cancelled and archived records and clearing after completion.
